name: What are the first steps after an FSBO consultation if I decide to sell myself?

mainEntity.name: What are the first steps after an FSBO consultation if I decide to sell myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: After an FSBO consultation, if you decide to proceed with selling your home independently, the first steps typically involve finalizing your pricing strategy, preparing your home for showings, and implementing the marketing plan we discussed. You'll also need to gather all necessary documentation, such as property surveys or HOA information if applicable. Your specific next steps will be tailored based on your property and the market in your area, and the consultation will equip you to execute these effectively.
